rem-fd-turbulence-and-closure-scope.physical_scope: Formal finite weighted averaging of smooth incompressible model fields and contextual limits on closure claims. No statistical averaging theorem, empirical turbulence observation, closure law, scaling law, or universality result is asserted.

ex-fd-reynolds-stress-sign-and-units.physical_scope: A two-member constant-velocity example in a formal constant-density incompressible model, used only to distinguish covariance from the signed effective stress contribution and to check SI units. It reports no measurement and proposes no closure law.
